description:
The CalculatorApp project is open in Android Studio. Users have reported several issues:

1. The app crashes when pressing the % button with certain inputs
2. The +/- button also causes crashes in some cases
3. The calculation history only shows the last 5 entries — users want to see the last 10
4. There's no visual indicator showing when a value is stored in memory

Investigate the code, fix the crash bugs, and implement the requested enhancements. The calculator engine (CalcEngine.kt) and UI controller (CalcActivity.kt) are the main files to examine.

Login credentials: user 'ga', password 'password123'.

After all changes, ensure the project compiles.
